title: LocalFlow M14 Adversarial Corpus
purpose: Machine-readable test specifications and deterministic fixture recipes for local binding. This JSON is not a runnable target harness and contains no claim of observed target behavior.

review.description: Synthetic store, fixed UTC clock, isolated artifact root, own producer-shaped jobs/examples. Raw/applied text: Please check the modul before the final test today. Corrected: Please check the module before the final test today.
bindings: Use current production fixture factories; assert artifact job_id/role/stage against producer contract before corrupting one field.
No live personal database, notes, usage, clipboard or model calls.

export.description: At least 20 independent families; own retained original-audio WAVs and explicit synthetic listened references; correct intended-writing records; one weak graft; one accepted transform; two same-input preference outputs. Distinct source canaries A_ONLY_41 and B_ONLY_73.

audio.generation: deterministic synthesized tones, not recorded voices

bindings: Latest envelopes must use the exact role names emitted by current producers; do not guess raw/normalized role strings.
Qualify the positive source graph first. A corruption case changes only its named variable.

approval.description: Synthetic M05 vocabulary store, app scope com.synthetic.editor, one live module/modul correction candidate; user alias and adverse phrase canaries kept distinct.
bindings: Exercise actual VocabularySnapshot/sandbox and real coordinator where requested.
Record entry ID, revision, alias ownership and pipeline outputs before/after.

notes.description: Synthetic note with explicit whitespace-word origin map and per-dictation job IDs, typed-only region and an optional transform region. Distinct A/B evidence links.
bindings: Author origin/occurrence oracle independently of SequenceMatcher.
Represent char and whitespace-word spans separately; retain exact original whitespace.

profile.description: Ten distinct synthetic dictations totaling exactly 2,000 whitespace words at the positive boundary, with designated repeated phrase/card support and synthetic usage facts.
bindings: Independently count exact words, dedupe policy and each card support set.
All profile phrases and com.synthetic.* app identities are synthetic.

performance.description: Synthetic 10,000-example store, 1,000 observation rows with independently identified actual edits, populated notes, 400 generated 10-second WAVs when retaining the historical large-audio shape.
bindings: Report actual unique/deduplicated eligibility and audio bytes; do not assume nominal rows equal work.
No timing alongside tests, another benchmark or independent-review workload from this session.

driver_contract.environment: Daniel’s actual Mac and project .venv; synthetic temporary stores/artifacts/audio only.
driver_contract.binding: Before executing, map operation names to actual current production call sites using local rg; exporter is DatasetExporter, not a presumed ExportService. Record adapter revision and exact tested production SHA.
driver_contract.oracle: Do not use the mutated/production decision function to generate expected labels, ownership, counts, family partitions or preferred identity.
driver_contract.positive_controls: Every refusal/error cohort requires a real eligible companion. Counters alone are not evidence that the branch performed work.
driver_contract.policy_cases: Resolve named DESIGN CONCERN with a versioned decision before grading; no invented latest-wins or scope policy. Record NOT_APPLICABLE only with decision/evidence, never as PASS.
driver_contract.barriers: Use deterministic query/writer/publication barriers. Do not sleep to manufacture races or deadlock the single writer waiting for another writer.
driver_contract.results: Keep this immutable specification separate from base/final execution-result files. Per-case results include exact SHA, driver hash, disposition, reachability, assertions and content-free evidence references.
driver_contract.privacy: Never use personal transcripts/notes/apps/audio; scan all generated evidence and exception fragments before Git commits.
driver_contract.qualification: A schema-valid JSON file is not target execution; every case here remains NOT_RUN.

finding_reproductions.title: Artifact existence is accepted as evidence authority
steps: Create independently eligible A and B, distinct original-audio canaries, own reviewed references, and a valid family assignment.
Change only A’s latest original_audio reference to B’s retained audio; preserve A’s job identity. Repeat with wrong-role same-job audio and foreign/wrong-stage cleanup source.
Run the gate, readiness and an actual selected-view export; inspect copied bytes and ownership independently.
finding_reproductions.expected: Every foreign/wrong-role row is refused or excluded with a content-free reason; B’s uncorrupted positive control remains eligible. No foreign canary enters A’s exported record.

finding_reproductions.title: Exporter recursively removes an unowned staging directory
steps: In a synthetic temporary parent create .dataset.building/UNRELATED_KEEP with unique bytes; leave dataset absent.
Invoke build for dataset with a valid store; also repeat with consent disabled.
Record filesystem operations and compare the sentinel byte-for-byte.
finding_reproductions.expected: Refuse the collision without changing any existing file. Remove only an exclusively created, operation-owned staging tree.

finding_reproductions.title: Your Voice can publish speech after its source artifact was purged
steps: Seed ten unique eligible dictations totaling at least 2,000 words and a repeated synthetic phrase supported by designated raw artifacts.
Latch computation after reading one supporting artifact but before final commit. Purge that artifact through the store while leaving its example trainable.
Release computation; inspect current() and all published snapshot data for the phrase and its support.
finding_reproductions.expected: Abort/recompute against current qualified inputs; do not publish the purged phrase. A no-purge companion publishes a valid snapshot. Test label/exclusion/revision changes at the same fence separately.

finding_reproductions.title: A new export can reclaim frozen-test status from an older assignment
steps: Create a valid v1 assignment containing a frozen family F and eligible source records.
Expose F so the current assignment carries its regression/development status. Keep v1 unchanged.
Build a NEW frozen_test export explicitly using assignment_version=v1.
finding_reproductions.expected: Refuse or explicitly mark the exposed family non-blind in the new export; never emit a fresh frozen_test/exposed=false claim. Reproducing historical bytes must be a separately labeled non-qualification operation.

finding_reproductions.title: Audio export trusts an unconstrained stored source path
steps: Place an outside synthetic WAV sentinel next to, not inside, the managed artifact root.
Point an eligible audio row at its absolute path, ../ path, then an in-root symlink; use the sentinel digest.
Export and record file opens/copies. Include a legitimate managed WAV positive control.
finding_reproductions.expected: Refuse before opening outside bytes; only managed regular files of the expected identity are copied.

finding_reproductions.title: Export publication is outside the final source-liveness fence
steps: Prepare a valid nonempty export.
Latch immediately after successful final store recheck and before staging publication; purge a selected input or revoke export consent.
Release publication and inspect destination and export-manifest status. Repeat with unrelated source deletion.
finding_reproductions.expected: No completed export contains the deleted selected source. Unrelated deletion must not abort the companion. A documented publication linearization point and dependency semantics must be explicit.

finding_reproductions.title: Portable export cannot independently reconstruct or qualify its full evidence graph
steps: Export a populated five-view fixture, remove access to the live DB and network, and reconstruct each task from exported bytes only.
For each view demand the exact source, reviewed authority and family lineage; inventory missing targets.
Create a semantic ownership/task mismatch in a synthetic package and consistently recompute hashes/fingerprint; require the validator to reject it independently.
finding_reproductions.expected: Task reconstruction and semantic lineage validation succeed without live DB/source payloads; corrupt-but-self-consistent lineage is rejected. Honest incomplete research records must not be labeled fully qualified.

finding_reproductions.title: Preference selection ignores the liveness of its source task
steps: Create two outputs of one valid task, explicit prefer_b, and retained source text.
Purge only the shared task source; keep outputs and judgment.
Query preference readiness/selection and build preference_pairs; compare with a source-live positive pair.
finding_reproductions.expected: The purged-input pair becomes incomplete/ineligible and is refused or excluded; the live pair exports B with the retained exact task input.

finding_reproductions.title: Approval can install a rule after its candidate was revoked
steps: Seed one approvable, live candidate and no existing vocabulary entry.
Latch after plan persistence; delete its example/job or reject it, then release vocabulary application.
Inspect real M05 normalization, candidate status, plan and dictionary history; retry once with the same logical action.
finding_reproductions.expected: No rule is installed after prior revocation; or a proven atomic operation linearizes approval first and deletion follows its documented policy. Every effect has one recoverable approved operation identity.

finding_reproductions.title: Undo is not confined to the original vocabulary delta

For alias_added, latch after undo reads aliases; add a second user alias through M05; release undo.
Exercise approve→undo→reapprove and a manually disabled entry separately.
finding_reproductions.expected: Only the learning-owned delta is reversed, or a stale-revision conflict is honestly refused. User changes remain byte-for-byte and behaviorally intact.

finding_reproductions.title: Teach does not bind to the immutable final text the reviewer saw

Repeat collection on/off and verify the existing transformed-final UI refusal as a preservation control.

finding_reproductions.title: Confirmed graft offsets are not bound to the displayed source identity
